## Resume: `specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md`

**Reconcile.** No stage is stamped COMPLETE and no plan Handoff exists, so nothing needs amending. Stage 1 is unticked and consumes nothing, so it is the next stage.

**But this roadmap was never approved.** A sub-agent wrote it on 2026-11-05 in a run that could not ask questions. That means it still has open items:

- The ranking is provisional. It is the list order, not your ranking.
- The tracks were never confirmed.
- O5 is only a suggestion.

The approval checkpoint comes before Stage 1, so I'm handing nothing off yet.

**One change I'd propose.** O4, the closure-history map for boat operators, serves a different use from O1–O3. The map stands on its own without the river-level model, because it needs only the closure log. Kept in Track A, it waits behind a research result it doesn't use. My default:

- **Track A, research:** O1, O2, O3. Stage 1 stays as written. O2 and O3 wait in its Ranked list.
- **Track B, known progression:** O4. It gets one core stage: the map built from the real closure log, with the build time recorded. Stage 1 also stops listing the map in its `Leaves out`.

**One suggested later quality, traceability:** "Each closure estimate traceable to the gauge readings it came from" (currently O5). This project will need it because O2's daily outlooks will be acted on by operators. When a forecast is questioned, you'll want to show which gauge readings produced it. If you approve it, it joins Track A's Ranked list at the place you give it.

---

**Your one decision:** do you approve this partition (the Track A / Track B split, plus traceability as O5), or amend it? Please include:

- your ranking of O2, O3 and O5 within Track A,
- your ranking of the two tracks against each other,
- whether you want O5 at all.

Once you answer, I'll update the roadmap and remove the "unapproved" note. I'll commit it on `main` and then give you the `Next:` line for Stage 1, or for Track B's stage if you rank that track first.
